whenToUse: People choose colors to tell things apart, such as tags, calendars, or labels.
The usable colors are fixed, as with brand colors.
The result can be previewed right away.
whenNotToUse: Color is the only way meaning is conveyed (add a name or icon too).
Precise color adjustment, as in design tools (use a dedicated picker).
There are only two or three options and names matter more (use a radio group).

alternatives.name: Radio Group
alternatives.reason: When choosing by name is clearer.

accessibility: Swatches are native radios with names (blue, green), chosen with the arrow keys.
The chosen swatch shows a thick border as well as its color.
The chosen color code is shown as text, so it can be checked without seeing the color.
Custom picking uses the browser's input type=color as is.
